title: A unit vector of span{z, e} near z lies on one of the two arcs from z at angle below L
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and z, e ∈ ℝ^P with ‖z‖ = 1, ‖e‖ = 1 and ⟨z, e⟩ = 0. Let w ∈ ℝ^P with ‖w‖ = 1 and w = ⟨w, z⟩ z + ⟨w, e⟩ e, and let L ∈ ℝ with ‖w − z‖ < L/2. Then there are θ ∈ ℝ and v ∈ ℝ^P with 0 ≤ θ < L, v = e or v = −e, and w = cos θ · z + sin θ · v.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (z e w : Euclid P) (L : ℝ), ‖z‖ = 1 → ‖e‖ = 1 → inner ℝ z e = 0 → ‖w‖ = 1 → w = inner ℝ w z • z + inner ℝ w e • e → ‖w - z‖ < L / 2 → ∃ (θ : ℝ) (v : Euclid P), 0 ≤ θ ∧ θ < L ∧ (v = e ∨ v = -e) ∧ w = Real.cos θ • z + Real.sin θ • v
